# AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/generators/gen_launch_windows.py - do not edit manually.

# Launch windows for Solar System Colonization (Global Commons spec § 5.3).
# Month indices are te_history_month_index's (year * 12 + month, January = 0;
# common/script_values/te_history_values.txt). Any scope. Read once a month by
# sr_launch_windows_refresh_cache (common/scripted_effects/
# sr_launch_window_effects.txt), which caches them in global variables for the
# rest of the script and the panel.
#   sr_window_next_<body>            one branch per cycle, guarded by `year` in
#                                    20-year blocks: the optimum month of the
#                                    current or next window (it switches the
#                                    month after a window closes), and as two
#                                    decimals the months since the optimum
#                                    before it (24395.26: optimum 24395, the
#                                    previous one 26 months earlier). The
#                                    comment is the window, year.month.
#   sr_window_months_to_next_<body>  months to the first month of the current
#                                    or next window (0 while it is open)
#   sr_launch_offset_<body>          signed months from the nearest optimum
#   sr_launch_premium_<body>         the off-window premium at that offset, a
#                                    fraction (0.35 = +35%); 0 in the window
#   sr_launch_premium_ntp_<body>     the same for a nuclear thermal engine: the
#                                    extra delta-v at 9 km/s, not 3.7 (lunar
#                                    colonization design § 9)
# The optima's dates are in docs/engine/launch_windows_report.md.

sr_window_next_optimum_mars = {
	value = sr_window_next_mars
	floor = yes
}
sr_window_previous_gap_mars = {
	value = sr_window_next_mars
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_mars
	multiply = 100
	round = yes
}
sr_window_months_to_next_mars = {
	value = sr_window_next_optimum_mars
	subtract = 1
	subtract = te_history_month_index
	min = 0
}
sr_launch_offset_mars = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_mars
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_nearer_previous_mars <= 0 }
		add = sr_window_previous_gap_mars
	}
}
sr_launch_nearer_previous_mars = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_mars
	multiply = 2
	add = sr_window_previous_gap_mars
}

# Premium by months from the optimum (fraction; 0.35 = +35%), from the mean extra delta-v of 16 cycles,
# chemical then nuclear thermal (sr_launch_premium_ntp_<body>, the same delta-v at 9 km/s):
#   -14:    3.35, NTP   0.83 (chemical cycles 290% to 411%)
#   -13:    4.76, NTP   1.05 (chemical cycles 377% to 607%)
#   -12:    8.61, NTP   1.54 (chemical cycles 625% to 1167%)
#   -11:    18.6, NTP    2.4 (chemical cycles 1281% to 2711%)
#   -10:   37.11, NTP   3.47 (chemical cycles 2066% to 6244%)
#    -9:   28.96, NTP   3.05 (chemical cycles 1508% to 4703%)
#    -8:   19.01, NTP   2.43 (chemical cycles 1079% to 2718%)
#    -7:   11.85, NTP   1.86 (chemical cycles 758% to 1644%)
#    -6:    6.74, NTP   1.32 (chemical cycles 476% to 934%)
#    -5:    3.61, NTP   0.87 (chemical cycles 269% to 505%)
#    -4:    1.79, NTP   0.52 (chemical cycles 127% to 251%)
#    -3:    0.81, NTP   0.28 (chemical cycles 51% to 118%)
#    -2:    0.24, NTP   0.09 (chemical cycles 11% to 40%)
#    -1:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +0:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +1:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +2:    0.43, NTP   0.16 (chemical cycles 20% to 83%)
#    +3:     1.5, NTP   0.46 (chemical cycles 98% to 202%)
#    +4:    2.56, NTP   0.69 (chemical cycles 216% to 303%)
#    +5:    3.34, NTP   0.83 (chemical cycles 281% to 403%)
#    +6:    3.61, NTP   0.87 (chemical cycles 271% to 449%)
#    +7:    3.23, NTP   0.81 (chemical cycles 236% to 402%)
#    +8:    2.78, NTP   0.73 (chemical cycles 211% to 337%)
#    +9:    2.51, NTP   0.68 (chemical cycles 208% to 291%)
#   +10:    2.52, NTP   0.68 (chemical cycles 225% to 283%)
#   +11:     2.9, NTP   0.75 (chemical cycles 256% to 333%)
#   +12:    4.41, NTP      1 (chemical cycles 344% to 579%)
#   +13:    8.25, NTP    1.5 (chemical cycles 606% to 1135%)
#   +14:   17.33, NTP   2.31 (chemical cycles 1207% to 2472%)
sr_launch_premium_mars = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < -7 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < -11 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < -13 }
					value = 3.35 # offset -14
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < -12 }
						value = 4.76 # offset -13
					}
					else = {
						value = 8.61 # offset -12
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < -9 }
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < -10 }
						value = 18.6 # offset -11
					}
					else = {
						value = 37.11 # offset -10
					}
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < -8 }
						value = 28.96 # offset -9
					}
					else = {
						value = 19.01 # offset -8
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < -4 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < -6 }
					value = 11.85 # offset -7
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < -5 }
						value = 6.74 # offset -6
					}
					else = {
						value = 3.61 # offset -5
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < -2 }
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < -3 }
						value = 1.79 # offset -4
					}
					else = {
						value = 0.81 # offset -3
					}
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < -1 }
						value = 0.24 # offset -2
					}
					else = {
						value = 0 # offset -1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < 7 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < 3 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < 1 }
					value = 0 # offset +0
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < 2 }
						value = 0 # offset +1
					}
					else = {
						value = 0.43 # offset +2
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < 5 }
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < 4 }
						value = 1.5 # offset +3
					}
					else = {
						value = 2.56 # offset +4
					}
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < 6 }
						value = 3.34 # offset +5
					}
					else = {
						value = 3.61 # offset +6
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < 11 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < 9 }
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < 8 }
						value = 3.23 # offset +7
					}
					else = {
						value = 2.78 # offset +8
					}
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < 10 }
						value = 2.51 # offset +9
					}
					else = {
						value = 2.52 # offset +10
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < 13 }
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < 12 }
						value = 2.9 # offset +11
					}
					else = {
						value = 4.41 # offset +12
					}
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < 14 }
						value = 8.25 # offset +13
					}
					else = {
						value = 17.33 # offset +14
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < -11 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_mars < -13 }
					value = 0.83 # offset -14

# Transit months by drive (slices 2-3 design § 2): chemical the median Hohmann time (265 days) whatever the month; the others by months from the optimum,
# a departure on day 15 averaged over the same 16 cycles:
#   -14: fusion 6, torch 1, antimatter 1
#   -13: fusion 5, torch 1, antimatter 1
#   -12: fusion 5, torch 1, antimatter 1
#   -11: fusion 5, torch 1, antimatter 1

#    -4: fusion 5, torch 1, antimatter 1

#    -2: fusion 4, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    -1: fusion 3, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +0: fusion 3, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +1: fusion 2, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +2: fusion 2, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +3: fusion 2, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +4: fusion 3, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +5: fusion 4, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +6: fusion 6, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +7: fusion 8, torch 1, antimatter 1

#   +14: fusion 5, torch 1, antimatter 1

sr_transit_fusion_mars = {
	value = 0

	}

				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {

sr_window_next_optimum_ceres = {
	value = sr_window_next_ceres
	floor = yes
}
sr_window_previous_gap_ceres = {
	value = sr_window_next_ceres
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_ceres
	multiply = 100
	round = yes
}
sr_window_months_to_next_ceres = {
	value = sr_window_next_optimum_ceres
	subtract = 1
	subtract = te_history_month_index
	min = 0
}
sr_launch_offset_ceres = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_ceres
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_nearer_previous_ceres <= 0 }
		add = sr_window_previous_gap_ceres
	}
}
sr_launch_nearer_previous_ceres = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_ceres
	multiply = 2
	add = sr_window_previous_gap_ceres
}

# Premium by months from the optimum (fraction; 0.35 = +35%), from the mean extra delta-v of 16 cycles,
# chemical then nuclear thermal (sr_launch_premium_ntp_<body>, the same delta-v at 9 km/s):
#    -9:   13.05, NTP   1.96 (chemical cycles 284% to 3609%)
#    -8:    35.4, NTP   3.38 (chemical cycles 426% to 13988%)
#    -7:   87.16, NTP   5.31 (chemical cycles 829% to 31977%)
#    -6:  108.14, NTP   5.88 (chemical cycles 2864% to 38394%)
#    -5:   33.95, NTP   3.31 (chemical cycles 852% to 13629%)
#    -4:    9.34, NTP   1.61 (chemical cycles 262% to 2996%)
#    -3:    2.84, NTP   0.74 (chemical cycles 79% to 796%)
#    -2:    0.76, NTP   0.26 (chemical cycles 9% to 214%)
#    -1:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +0:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +1:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +2:    0.46, NTP   0.17 (chemical cycles 0% to 219%)
#    +3:    1.91, NTP   0.55 (chemical cycles 33% to 633%)
#    +4:    3.28, NTP   0.82 (chemical cycles 107% to 732%)
#    +5:    4.22, NTP   0.97 (chemical cycles 148% to 641%)
#    +6:     9.1, NTP   1.59 (chemical cycles 319% to 3483%)
#    +7:   21.96, NTP   2.63 (chemical cycles 746% to 11764%)
#    +8:    62.6, NTP   4.51 (chemical cycles 3137% to 16505%)
#    +9:  104.13, NTP   5.78 (chemical cycles 5550% to 28092%)
sr_launch_premium_ceres = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < -5 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < -7 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < -8 }
					value = 13.05 # offset -9
				}
				else = {
					value = 35.4 # offset -8
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < -6 }
					value = 87.16 # offset -7
				}
				else = {
					value = 108.14 # offset -6
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < -3 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < -4 }
					value = 33.95 # offset -5
				}
				else = {
					value = 9.34 # offset -4
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < -2 }
					value = 2.84 # offset -3
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < -1 }
						value = 0.76 # offset -2
					}
					else = {
						value = 0 # offset -1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < 5 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < 2 }
				value = 0 # offsets +0 to +1
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < 3 }
					value = 0.46 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < 4 }
						value = 1.91 # offset +3
					}
					else = {
						value = 3.28 # offset +4
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < 7 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < 6 }
					value = 4.22 # offset +5
				}
				else = {
					value = 9.1 # offset +6
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < 8 }
					value = 21.96 # offset +7
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < 9 }
						value = 62.6 # offset +8
					}
					else = {
						value = 104.13 # offset +9
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Transit months by drive (slices 2-3 design § 2): chemical the median Hohmann time (481 days) whatever the month; the others by months from the optimum,
# a departure on day 15 averaged over the same 16 cycles:
#    -9: fusion 16, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    -8: fusion 16, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -7: fusion 16, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -6: fusion 16, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -5: fusion 11, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -4: fusion 9, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -3: fusion 9, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -2: fusion 10, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -1: fusion 9, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +0: fusion 6, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +1: fusion 6, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +2: fusion 6, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +3: fusion 8, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +4: fusion 14, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +5: fusion 16, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +6: fusion 16, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +7: fusion 16, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +8: fusion 16, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +9: fusion 16, torch 2, antimatter 1
sr_transit_chemical_ceres = { value = 16 }
sr_transit_fusion_ceres = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < -5 }
			value = 16 # offsets -9 to -6
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < -3 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < -4 }
					value = 11 # offset -5
				}
				else = {
					value = 9 # offset -4
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < -2 }
					value = 9 # offset -3
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < -1 }
						value = 10 # offset -2
					}
					else = {
						value = 9 # offset -1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < 5 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < 2 }
				value = 6 # offsets +0 to +1
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < 3 }
					value = 6 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < 4 }
						value = 8 # offset +3
					}
					else = {
						value = 14 # offset +4
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			value = 16 # offsets +5 to +9
		}
	}
}
sr_transit_torch_ceres = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < -5 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < -7 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < -8 }
					value = 1 # offset -9
				}
				else = {
					value = 2 # offset -8
				}
			}
			else = {
				value = 2 # offsets -7 to -6
			}
		}
		else = {
			value = 2 # offsets -5 to -1
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < 5 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < 2 }
				value = 2 # offsets +0 to +1
			}
			else = {
				value = 1 # offsets +2 to +4
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_ceres < 7 }
				value = 1 # offsets +5 to +6
			}
			else = {
				value = 2 # offsets +7 to +9
			}
		}
	}
}
sr_transit_antimatter_ceres = {
	value = 0
	value = 1 # offsets -9 to +9
}

sr_window_next_optimum_vesta = {
	value = sr_window_next_vesta
	floor = yes
}
sr_window_previous_gap_vesta = {
	value = sr_window_next_vesta
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_vesta
	multiply = 100
	round = yes
}
sr_window_months_to_next_vesta = {
	value = sr_window_next_optimum_vesta
	subtract = 1
	subtract = te_history_month_index
	min = 0
}
sr_launch_offset_vesta = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_vesta
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_nearer_previous_vesta <= 0 }
		add = sr_window_previous_gap_vesta
	}
}
sr_launch_nearer_previous_vesta = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_vesta
	multiply = 2
	add = sr_window_previous_gap_vesta
}

# Premium by months from the optimum (fraction; 0.35 = +35%), from the mean extra delta-v of 16 cycles,
# chemical then nuclear thermal (sr_launch_premium_ntp_<body>, the same delta-v at 9 km/s):
#    -9:   20.57, NTP   2.53 (chemical cycles 598% to 16288%)
#    -8:   61.21, NTP   4.46 (chemical cycles 1094% to 22278%)
#    -7:  151.22, NTP   6.89 (chemical cycles 6877% to 33933%)
#    -6:   97.25, NTP   5.59 (chemical cycles 2615% to 31549%)
#    -5:   25.43, NTP   2.84 (chemical cycles 811% to 7218%)
#    -4:    7.54, NTP   1.41 (chemical cycles 273% to 2092%)
#    -3:    2.34, NTP   0.64 (chemical cycles 77% to 745%)
#    -2:    0.52, NTP   0.19 (chemical cycles 3% to 197%)
#    -1:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +0:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +1:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +2:    0.73, NTP   0.25 (chemical cycles 9% to 234%)
#    +3:    2.33, NTP   0.64 (chemical cycles 93% to 498%)
#    +4:    3.73, NTP   0.89 (chemical cycles 193% to 699%)
#    +5:    4.81, NTP   1.06 (chemical cycles 181% to 944%)
#    +6:    5.45, NTP   1.15 (chemical cycles 163% to 1320%)
#    +7:    6.73, NTP   1.32 (chemical cycles 180% to 2078%)
#    +8:   18.31, NTP   2.38 (chemical cycles 303% to 16826%)
#    +9:   65.93, NTP   4.63 (chemical cycles 995% to 25972%)
sr_launch_premium_vesta = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < -5 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < -7 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < -8 }
					value = 20.57 # offset -9
				}
				else = {
					value = 61.21 # offset -8
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < -6 }
					value = 151.22 # offset -7
				}
				else = {
					value = 97.25 # offset -6
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < -3 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < -4 }
					value = 25.43 # offset -5
				}
				else = {
					value = 7.54 # offset -4
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < -2 }
					value = 2.34 # offset -3
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < -1 }
						value = 0.52 # offset -2
					}
					else = {
						value = 0 # offset -1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < 5 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < 2 }
				value = 0 # offsets +0 to +1
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < 3 }
					value = 0.73 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < 4 }
						value = 2.33 # offset +3
					}
					else = {
						value = 3.73 # offset +4
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < 7 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < 6 }
					value = 4.81 # offset +5
				}
				else = {
					value = 5.45 # offset +6
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < 8 }
					value = 6.73 # offset +7
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < 9 }
						value = 18.31 # offset +8
					}
					else = {
						value = 65.93 # offset +9
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
sr_launch_premium_ntp_vesta = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < -5 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < -7 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < -8 }
					value = 2.53 # offset -9
				}
				else = {
					value = 4.46 # offset -8
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < -6 }
					value = 6.89 # offset -7
				}
				else = {
					value = 5.59 # offset -6
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < -3 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < -4 }
					value = 2.84 # offset -5
				}
				else = {
					value = 1.41 # offset -4
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < -2 }
					value = 0.64 # offset -3
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < -1 }
						value = 0.19 # offset -2
					}
					else = {
						value = 0 # offset -1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < 5 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < 2 }
				value = 0 # offsets +0 to +1
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < 3 }
					value = 0.25 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < 4 }
						value = 0.64 # offset +3
					}
					else = {
						value = 0.89 # offset +4
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < 7 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < 6 }
					value = 1.06 # offset +5
				}
				else = {
					value = 1.15 # offset +6
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < 8 }
					value = 1.32 # offset +7
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < 9 }
						value = 2.38 # offset +8
					}
					else = {
						value = 4.63 # offset +9
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Transit months by drive (slices 2-3 design § 2): chemical the median Hohmann time (404 days) whatever the month; the others by months from the optimum,
# a departure on day 15 averaged over the same 16 cycles:
#    -9: fusion 13, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    -8: fusion 13, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -7: fusion 13, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -6: fusion 10, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -5: fusion 9, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -4: fusion 8, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -3: fusion 8, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -2: fusion 8, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -1: fusion 6, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +0: fusion 5, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +1: fusion 5, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +2: fusion 5, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +3: fusion 6, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +4: fusion 10, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +5: fusion 13, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +6: fusion 13, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +7: fusion 13, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +8: fusion 13, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +9: fusion 13, torch 2, antimatter 1
sr_transit_chemical_vesta = { value = 13 }
sr_transit_fusion_vesta = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < -5 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < -7 }
				value = 13 # offsets -9 to -8
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < -6 }
					value = 13 # offset -7
				}
				else = {
					value = 10 # offset -6
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < -3 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < -4 }
					value = 9 # offset -5
				}
				else = {
					value = 8 # offset -4
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < -2 }
					value = 8 # offset -3
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_vesta < -1 }
						value = 8 # offset -2
					}
					else = {
						value = 6 # offset -1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {

			}
			else = {
				if = {

				}

					}
					else = {
						value = 10 # offset +4
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			value = 13 # offsets +5 to +9
		}
	}
}
sr_transit_torch_vesta = {

				}
				else = {
					value = 1 # offset +1
				}

			else = {

		}

	}
}

sr_window_next_optimum_psyche = {
	value = sr_window_next_psyche
	floor = yes
}
sr_window_previous_gap_psyche = {
	value = sr_window_next_psyche
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_psyche
	multiply = 100
	round = yes
}
sr_window_months_to_next_psyche = {
	value = sr_window_next_optimum_psyche
	subtract = 1
	subtract = te_history_month_index
	min = 0
}
sr_launch_offset_psyche = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_psyche
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_nearer_previous_psyche <= 0 }
		add = sr_window_previous_gap_psyche
	}
}
sr_launch_nearer_previous_psyche = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_psyche
	multiply = 2
	add = sr_window_previous_gap_psyche
}

# Premium by months from the optimum (fraction; 0.35 = +35%), from the mean extra delta-v of 16 cycles,
# chemical then nuclear thermal (sr_launch_premium_ntp_<body>, the same delta-v at 9 km/s):
#    -9:    7.51, NTP   1.41 (chemical cycles 301% to 1885%)
#    -8:   13.33, NTP   1.99 (chemical cycles 311% to 4203%)
#    -7:   28.61, NTP   3.03 (chemical cycles 383% to 14119%)
#    -6:   64.59, NTP   4.58 (chemical cycles 1905% to 26129%)
#    -5:   51.68, NTP    4.1 (chemical cycles 1987% to 10350%)
#    -4:   15.29, NTP   2.15 (chemical cycles 564% to 3272%)
#    -3:    4.07, NTP   0.95 (chemical cycles 159% to 788%)
#    -2:    0.76, NTP   0.26 (chemical cycles 29% to 156%)
#    -1:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +0:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +1:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +2:    0.89, NTP    0.3 (chemical cycles 28% to 178%)
#    +3:    2.36, NTP   0.65 (chemical cycles 79% to 410%)
#    +4:     3.9, NTP   0.92 (chemical cycles 102% to 671%)
#    +5:     5.5, NTP   1.16 (chemical cycles 121% to 1081%)
#    +6:    7.06, NTP   1.36 (chemical cycles 151% to 2230%)
#    +7:   11.75, NTP   1.85 (chemical cycles 216% to 9889%)
#    +8:   26.79, NTP   2.92 (chemical cycles 489% to 24635%)
#    +9:   59.87, NTP   4.41 (chemical cycles 1953% to 36823%)
sr_launch_premium_psyche = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < -5 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < -7 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < -8 }
					value = 7.51 # offset -9
				}
				else = {
					value = 13.33 # offset -8
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < -6 }
					value = 28.61 # offset -7
				}
				else = {
					value = 64.59 # offset -6
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < -3 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < -4 }
					value = 51.68 # offset -5
				}
				else = {
					value = 15.29 # offset -4
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < -2 }
					value = 4.07 # offset -3
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < -1 }
						value = 0.76 # offset -2
					}
					else = {
						value = 0 # offset -1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < 5 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < 2 }
				value = 0 # offsets +0 to +1
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < 3 }
					value = 0.89 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < 4 }
						value = 2.36 # offset +3
					}
					else = {
						value = 3.9 # offset +4
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < 7 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < 6 }
					value = 5.5 # offset +5
				}
				else = {
					value = 7.06 # offset +6
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < 8 }
					value = 11.75 # offset +7
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < 9 }
						value = 26.79 # offset +8
					}
					else = {
						value = 59.87 # offset +9
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

			else = {

					else = {

					}

# Transit months by drive (slices 2-3 design § 2): chemical the median Hohmann time (555 days) whatever the month; the others by months from the optimum,
# a departure on day 15 averaged over the same 16 cycles:
#    -9: fusion 18, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    -8: fusion 18, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -7: fusion 18, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -6: fusion 18, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -5: fusion 15, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -4: fusion 10, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -3: fusion 9, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -2: fusion 9, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -1: fusion 8, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +0: fusion 6, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +1: fusion 6, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +2: fusion 6, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +3: fusion 9, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +4: fusion 16, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +5: fusion 18, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +6: fusion 18, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +7: fusion 18, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +8: fusion 18, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +9: fusion 18, torch 2, antimatter 1
sr_transit_chemical_psyche = { value = 18 }
sr_transit_fusion_psyche = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < -5 }
			value = 18 # offsets -9 to -6
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < -3 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < -4 }
					value = 15 # offset -5
				}
				else = {
					value = 10 # offset -4
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < -2 }
					value = 9 # offset -3
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < -1 }
						value = 9 # offset -2
					}
					else = {
						value = 8 # offset -1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < 5 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < 2 }
				value = 6 # offsets +0 to +1
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < 3 }
					value = 6 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < 4 }
						value = 9 # offset +3
					}
					else = {
						value = 16 # offset +4
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			value = 18 # offsets +5 to +9
		}
	}
}
sr_transit_torch_psyche = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < -5 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < -7 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < -8 }
					value = 1 # offset -9
				}
				else = {
					value = 2 # offset -8
				}
			}
			else = {
				value = 2 # offsets -7 to -6
			}
		}
		else = {
			value = 2 # offsets -5 to -1
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < 5 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < 2 }
				value = 2 # offsets +0 to +1
			}
			else = {
				value = 1 # offsets +2 to +4
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_psyche < 7 }
				value = 1 # offsets +5 to +6
			}
			else = {
				value = 2 # offsets +7 to +9
			}
		}
	}
}

	value = 1 # offsets -9 to +9
}

sr_window_next_optimum_pallas = {
	value = sr_window_next_pallas
	floor = yes
}
sr_window_previous_gap_pallas = {
	value = sr_window_next_pallas
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_pallas
	multiply = 100
	round = yes
}
sr_window_months_to_next_pallas = {
	value = sr_window_next_optimum_pallas
	subtract = 1
	subtract = te_history_month_index
	min = 0
}
sr_launch_offset_pallas = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_pallas
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_nearer_previous_pallas <= 0 }
		add = sr_window_previous_gap_pallas
	}
}
sr_launch_nearer_previous_pallas = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_pallas
	multiply = 2
	add = sr_window_previous_gap_pallas
}

# Premium by months from the optimum (fraction; 0.35 = +35%), from the mean extra delta-v of 16 cycles,
# chemical then nuclear thermal (sr_launch_premium_ntp_<body>, the same delta-v at 9 km/s):
#   -10:    7.42, NTP    1.4 (chemical cycles 42% to 18506%)
#    -9:   19.51, NTP   2.46 (chemical cycles 43% to 14170%)
#    -8:   59.02, NTP   4.38 (chemical cycles 158% to 59481%)
#    -7:  151.01, NTP   6.89 (chemical cycles 588% to 100000%)
#    -6:  102.99, NTP   5.75 (chemical cycles 942% to 100000%)
#    -5:   38.69, NTP   3.54 (chemical cycles 338% to 26391%)
#    -4:   13.19, NTP   1.98 (chemical cycles 93% to 7000%)
#    -3:    5.38, NTP   1.14 (chemical cycles 1% to 1996%)
#    -2:    1.73, NTP   0.51 (chemical cycles 0% to 683%)
#    -1:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +0:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +1:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +2:    0.55, NTP    0.2 (chemical cycles 0% to 281%)
#    +3:    2.34, NTP   0.64 (chemical cycles 0% to 1799%)
#    +4:    6.09, NTP   1.24 (chemical cycles 0% to 4582%)
#    +5:    7.96, NTP   1.46 (chemical cycles 15% to 9777%)
#    +6:   13.57, NTP   2.01 (chemical cycles 6% to 33712%)
#    +7:   31.44, NTP   3.18 (chemical cycles 27% to 100000%)
#    +8:   74.83, NTP   4.93 (chemical cycles 112% to 59668%)
#    +9:   55.44, NTP   4.25 (chemical cycles 250% to 44117%)
#   +10:   20.63, NTP   2.54 (chemical cycles 237% to 12432%)
sr_launch_premium_pallas = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < -5 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < -8 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < -9 }
					value = 7.42 # offset -10
				}
				else = {
					value = 19.51 # offset -9
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < -7 }
					value = 59.02 # offset -8
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < -6 }
						value = 151.01 # offset -7
					}
					else = {
						value = 102.99 # offset -6
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < -3 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < -4 }
					value = 38.69 # offset -5
				}
				else = {
					value = 13.19 # offset -4
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < -2 }
					value = 5.38 # offset -3
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < -1 }
						value = 1.73 # offset -2
					}
					else = {
						value = 0 # offset -1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < 5 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < 2 }
				value = 0 # offsets +0 to +1
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < 3 }
					value = 0.55 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < 4 }
						value = 2.34 # offset +3
					}
					else = {
						value = 6.09 # offset +4
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < 8 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < 6 }
					value = 7.96 # offset +5
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < 7 }
						value = 13.57 # offset +6
					}
					else = {
						value = 31.44 # offset +7
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < 9 }

# Transit months by drive (slices 2-3 design § 2): chemical the median Hohmann time (509 days) whatever the month; the others by months from the optimum,
# a departure on day 15 averaged over the same 16 cycles:
#   -10: fusion 17, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    -9: fusion 17, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    -8: fusion 17, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -7: fusion 17, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -6: fusion 15, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -5: fusion 15, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -4: fusion 12, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -3: fusion 13, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -2: fusion 14, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -1: fusion 14, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +0: fusion 13, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +1: fusion 7, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +2: fusion 8, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +3: fusion 11, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +4: fusion 17, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +5: fusion 17, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +6: fusion 17, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +7: fusion 17, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +8: fusion 17, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +9: fusion 17, torch 2, antimatter 1
#   +10: fusion 17, torch 2, antimatter 1
sr_transit_chemical_pallas = { value = 17 }
sr_transit_fusion_pallas = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < -5 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < -8 }
				value = 17 # offsets -10 to -9
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < -7 }
					value = 17 # offset -8
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < -6 }
						value = 17 # offset -7
					}
					else = {
						value = 15 # offset -6
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < -3 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < -4 }
					value = 15 # offset -5
				}
				else = {
					value = 12 # offset -4
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < -2 }
					value = 13 # offset -3
				}
				else = {
					value = 14 # offsets -2 to -1
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < 5 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < 2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < 1 }
					value = 13 # offset +0
				}
				else = {
					value = 7 # offset +1
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < 3 }
					value = 8 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_pallas < 4 }
						value = 11 # offset +3
					}
					else = {
						value = 17 # offset +4
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			value = 17 # offsets +5 to +10
		}
	}
}

sr_window_next_optimum_hygiea = {
	value = sr_window_next_hygiea
	floor = yes
}
sr_window_previous_gap_hygiea = {
	value = sr_window_next_hygiea
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_hygiea
	multiply = 100
	round = yes
}
sr_window_months_to_next_hygiea = {
	value = sr_window_next_optimum_hygiea
	subtract = 1
	subtract = te_history_month_index
	min = 0
}
sr_launch_offset_hygiea = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_hygiea
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_nearer_previous_hygiea <= 0 }
		add = sr_window_previous_gap_hygiea
	}
}
sr_launch_nearer_previous_hygiea = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_hygiea
	multiply = 2
	add = sr_window_previous_gap_hygiea
}

# Premium by months from the optimum (fraction; 0.35 = +35%), from the mean extra delta-v of 16 cycles,
# chemical then nuclear thermal (sr_launch_premium_ntp_<body>, the same delta-v at 9 km/s):
#    -8:   14.88, NTP   2.12 (chemical cycles 469% to 5921%)
#    -7:   43.95, NTP   3.78 (chemical cycles 959% to 19027%)
#    -6:  130.57, NTP   6.43 (chemical cycles 3425% to 67199%)
#    -5:   68.95, NTP   4.73 (chemical cycles 2585% to 23481%)
#    -4:    17.4, NTP   2.31 (chemical cycles 653% to 4837%)
#    -3:    4.44, NTP   1.01 (chemical cycles 161% to 994%)
#    -2:     0.8, NTP   0.27 (chemical cycles 16% to 175%)
#    -1:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +0:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +1:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +2:    0.86, NTP   0.29 (chemical cycles 27% to 192%)
#    +3:    2.05, NTP   0.58 (chemical cycles 74% to 436%)
#    +4:    3.28, NTP   0.82 (chemical cycles 158% to 740%)
#    +5:    4.59, NTP   1.03 (chemical cycles 190% to 1073%)
#    +6:    8.73, NTP   1.55 (chemical cycles 197% to 3693%)
#    +7:   21.88, NTP   2.62 (chemical cycles 280% to 8496%)
#    +8:   68.32, NTP   4.71 (chemical cycles 1133% to 24080%)
sr_launch_premium_hygiea = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < -4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < -6 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < -7 }
					value = 14.88 # offset -8
				}
				else = {
					value = 43.95 # offset -7
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < -5 }
					value = 130.57 # offset -6
				}
				else = {
					value = 68.95 # offset -5
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < -2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < -3 }
					value = 17.4 # offset -4
				}
				else = {
					value = 4.44 # offset -3
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < -1 }
					value = 0.8 # offset -2
				}
				else = {
					value = 0 # offset -1
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < 4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < 2 }
				value = 0 # offsets +0 to +1
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < 3 }
					value = 0.86 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					value = 2.05 # offset +3
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < 6 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < 5 }
					value = 3.28 # offset +4
				}
				else = {
					value = 4.59 # offset +5
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < 7 }
					value = 8.73 # offset +6
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < 8 }
						value = 21.88 # offset +7
					}
					else = {
						value = 68.32 # offset +8
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
sr_launch_premium_ntp_hygiea = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < 0 }

					}

# Transit months by drive (slices 2-3 design § 2): chemical the median Hohmann time (556 days) whatever the month; the others by months from the optimum,
# a departure on day 15 averaged over the same 16 cycles:
#    -8: fusion 18, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -7: fusion 18, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -6: fusion 18, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -5: fusion 15, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -4: fusion 11, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -3: fusion 10, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -2: fusion 10, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -1: fusion 8, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +0: fusion 7, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +1: fusion 6, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +2: fusion 7, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +3: fusion 10, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +4: fusion 17, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +5: fusion 18, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +6: fusion 18, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +7: fusion 18, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +8: fusion 18, torch 2, antimatter 1
sr_transit_chemical_hygiea = { value = 18 }
sr_transit_fusion_hygiea = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < -4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < -6 }
				value = 18 # offsets -8 to -7
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < -5 }
					value = 18 # offset -6
				}
				else = {
					value = 15 # offset -5
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < -2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < -3 }
					value = 11 # offset -4
				}
				else = {
					value = 10 # offset -3
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < -1 }
					value = 10 # offset -2
				}
				else = {
					value = 8 # offset -1
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < 4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < 2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < 1 }
					value = 7 # offset +0
				}
				else = {
					value = 6 # offset +1
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < 3 }
					value = 7 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					value = 10 # offset +3
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < 6 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < 5 }
					value = 17 # offset +4
				}
				else = {
					value = 18 # offset +5
				}
			}
			else = {
				value = 18 # offsets +6 to +8
			}
		}
	}
}
sr_transit_torch_hygiea = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < 0 }

			limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < 4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < 2 }

			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < 3 }
					value = 2 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					value = 1 # offset +3
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_hygiea < 6 }
				value = 1 # offsets +4 to +5
			}
			else = {
				value = 2 # offsets +6 to +8
			}
		}
	}
}

	value = 1 # offsets -8 to +8
}

sr_window_next_optimum_jupiter = {
	value = sr_window_next_jupiter
	floor = yes
}
sr_window_previous_gap_jupiter = {
	value = sr_window_next_jupiter
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_jupiter
	multiply = 100
	round = yes
}
sr_window_months_to_next_jupiter = {
	value = sr_window_next_optimum_jupiter
	subtract = 1
	subtract = te_history_month_index
	min = 0
}
sr_launch_offset_jupiter = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_jupiter
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_nearer_previous_jupiter <= 0 }
		add = sr_window_previous_gap_jupiter
	}
}
sr_launch_nearer_previous_jupiter = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_jupiter
	multiply = 2
	add = sr_window_previous_gap_jupiter
}

# Premium by months from the optimum (fraction; 0.35 = +35%), from the mean extra delta-v of 16 cycles,
# chemical then nuclear thermal (sr_launch_premium_ntp_<body>, the same delta-v at 9 km/s):
#    -7:    4.87, NTP   1.07 (chemical cycles 229% to 1496%)
#    -6:   20.24, NTP   2.51 (chemical cycles 551% to 7284%)
#    -5:   71.68, NTP   4.82 (chemical cycles 2511% to 11927%)
#    -4:   31.55, NTP   3.19 (chemical cycles 1557% to 7434%)
#    -3:    7.49, NTP   1.41 (chemical cycles 364% to 1709%)
#    -2:    1.25, NTP   0.39 (chemical cycles 45% to 290%)
#    -1:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +0:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +1:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +2:    0.13, NTP   0.05 (chemical cycles 2% to 28%)
#    +3:    0.24, NTP   0.09 (chemical cycles 9% to 40%)
#    +4:    0.36, NTP   0.14 (chemical cycles 20% to 66%)
#    +5:     1.2, NTP   0.38 (chemical cycles 43% to 273%)
#    +6:    3.91, NTP   0.92 (chemical cycles 97% to 1258%)
#    +7:   17.27, NTP    2.3 (chemical cycles 430% to 5642%)
sr_launch_premium_jupiter = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < -4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < -6 }
				value = 4.87 # offset -7
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < -5 }
					value = 20.24 # offset -6
				}
				else = {
					value = 71.68 # offset -5
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < -2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < -3 }
					value = 31.55 # offset -4
				}
				else = {
					value = 7.49 # offset -3
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < -1 }
					value = 1.25 # offset -2
				}
				else = {
					value = 0 # offset -1
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < 4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < 2 }
				value = 0 # offsets +0 to +1
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < 3 }
					value = 0.13 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					value = 0.24 # offset +3
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < 6 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < 5 }
					value = 0.36 # offset +4
				}
				else = {
					value = 1.2 # offset +5
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < 7 }
					value = 3.91 # offset +6
				}
				else = {
					value = 17.27 # offset +7
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
sr_launch_premium_ntp_jupiter = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < -4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < -6 }
				value = 1.07 # offset -7
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < -5 }
					value = 2.51 # offset -6
				}
				else = {
					value = 4.82 # offset -5
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < -2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < -3 }
					value = 3.19 # offset -4
				}
				else = {
					value = 1.41 # offset -3
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < -1 }
					value = 0.39 # offset -2
				}
				else = {
					value = 0 # offset -1
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < 4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < 2 }
				value = 0 # offsets +0 to +1
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < 3 }
					value = 0.05 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					value = 0.09 # offset +3
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < 6 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < 5 }
					value = 0.14 # offset +4
				}
				else = {
					value = 0.38 # offset +5
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < 7 }
					value = 0.92 # offset +6
				}
				else = {
					value = 2.3 # offset +7
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Transit months by drive (slices 2-3 design § 2): chemical the median Hohmann time (1001 days) whatever the month; the others by months from the optimum,
# a departure on day 15 averaged over the same 16 cycles:
#    -7: fusion 33, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -6: fusion 33, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -5: fusion 27, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    -4: fusion 13, torch 3, antimatter 1
#    -3: fusion 12, torch 3, antimatter 1
#    -2: fusion 10, torch 3, antimatter 1
#    -1: fusion 9, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +0: fusion 8, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +1: fusion 7, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +2: fusion 8, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +3: fusion 14, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +4: fusion 27, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +5: fusion 33, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +6: fusion 33, torch 2, antimatter 1
#    +7: fusion 33, torch 2, antimatter 1
sr_transit_chemical_jupiter = { value = 33 }
sr_transit_fusion_jupiter = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < -4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < -6 }
				value = 33 # offset -7
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < -5 }
					value = 33 # offset -6
				}
				else = {
					value = 27 # offset -5
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < -2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < -3 }
					value = 13 # offset -4
				}
				else = {
					value = 12 # offset -3
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < -1 }
					value = 10 # offset -2
				}
				else = {
					value = 9 # offset -1
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < 4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < 2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < 1 }
					value = 8 # offset +0
				}
				else = {
					value = 7 # offset +1
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < 3 }
					value = 8 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					value = 14 # offset +3
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < 6 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < 5 }
					value = 27 # offset +4
				}
				else = {
					value = 33 # offset +5
				}
			}
			else = {
				value = 33 # offsets +6 to +7
			}
		}
	}
}
sr_transit_torch_jupiter = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < -4 }
			value = 2 # offsets -7 to -5
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < -2 }
				value = 3 # offsets -4 to -3
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_jupiter < -1 }
					value = 3 # offset -2
				}
				else = {
					value = 2 # offset -1
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		value = 2 # offsets +0 to +7
	}
}
sr_transit_antimatter_jupiter = {
	value = 0
	value = 1 # offsets -7 to +7
}

		if = { limit = { te_history_month_index <= 24972 } value = 24971.19 } # 2080.11–2081.01
		else_if = { limit = { te_history_month_index <= 24991 } value = 24990.19 } # 2082.06–2082.08

		else_if = { limit = { te_history_month_index <= 25049 } value = 25048.20 } # 2087.04–2087.06
		else_if = { limit = { te_history_month_index <= 25068 } value = 25067.19 } # 2088.11–2089.01
		else_if = { limit = { te_history_month_index <= 25087 } value = 25086.19 } # 2090.06–2090.08

		else_if = { limit = { te_history_month_index <= 25164 } value = 25163.20 } # 2096.11–2097.01
		else_if = { limit = { te_history_month_index <= 25183 } value = 25182.19 } # 2098.06–2098.08
		else = { value = 25201.19 } # 2100.01–2100.03
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { year < 2120 }
		if = { limit = { te_history_month_index <= 25202 } value = 25201.19 } # 2100.01–2100.03
		else_if = { limit = { te_history_month_index <= 25221 } value = 25220.19 } # 2101.08–2101.10

		else_if = { limit = { te_history_month_index <= 25432 } value = 25431.19 } # 2119.03–2119.05
		else = { value = 25450.19 } # 2120.10–2120.12
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { te_history_month_index <= 25451 } value = 25450.19 } # 2120.10–2120.12
		else_if = { limit = { te_history_month_index <= 25470 } value = 25469.19 } # 2122.05–2122.07

sr_window_next_optimum_venus = {
	value = sr_window_next_venus
	floor = yes
}
sr_window_previous_gap_venus = {
	value = sr_window_next_venus
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_venus
	multiply = 100
	round = yes
}
sr_window_months_to_next_venus = {
	value = sr_window_next_optimum_venus
	subtract = 1
	subtract = te_history_month_index
	min = 0
}
sr_launch_offset_venus = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_venus
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_nearer_previous_venus <= 0 }
		add = sr_window_previous_gap_venus
	}
}
sr_launch_nearer_previous_venus = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_venus
	multiply = 2
	add = sr_window_previous_gap_venus
}

# Premium by months from the optimum (fraction; 0.35 = +35%), from the mean extra delta-v of 16 cycles,
# chemical then nuclear thermal (sr_launch_premium_ntp_<body>, the same delta-v at 9 km/s):
#   -10:    1.45, NTP   0.45 (chemical cycles 109% to 182%)
#    -9:    1.24, NTP   0.39 (chemical cycles 99% to 151%)
#    -8:    1.02, NTP   0.34 (chemical cycles 86% to 119%)
#    -7:    0.81, NTP   0.28 (chemical cycles 67% to 94%)
#    -6:    0.63, NTP   0.22 (chemical cycles 46% to 78%)
#    -5:    0.46, NTP   0.17 (chemical cycles 26% to 68%)
#    -4:    0.31, NTP   0.12 (chemical cycles 13% to 57%)
#    -3:    0.18, NTP   0.07 (chemical cycles 2% to 41%)
#    -2:    0.08, NTP   0.03 (chemical cycles 0% to 19%)
#    -1:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +0:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +1:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +2:    0.28, NTP   0.11 (chemical cycles 5% to 73%)
#    +3:    1.01, NTP   0.33 (chemical cycles 62% to 157%)
#    +4:    2.06, NTP   0.58 (chemical cycles 126% to 299%)
#    +5:    2.56, NTP   0.68 (chemical cycles 228% to 285%)
#    +6:    2.29, NTP   0.63 (chemical cycles 198% to 261%)
#    +7:    2.01, NTP   0.57 (chemical cycles 168% to 247%)
#    +8:    1.75, NTP   0.52 (chemical cycles 139% to 230%)
#    +9:     1.5, NTP   0.46 (chemical cycles 114% to 202%)
#   +10:    1.26, NTP    0.4 (chemical cycles 92% to 169%)
sr_launch_premium_venus = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < -5 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < -8 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < -9 }
					value = 1.45 # offset -10
				}
				else = {
					value = 1.24 # offset -9
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < -7 }
					value = 1.02 # offset -8
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < -6 }
						value = 0.81 # offset -7
					}
					else = {
						value = 0.63 # offset -6
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < -3 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < -4 }
					value = 0.46 # offset -5
				}
				else = {
					value = 0.31 # offset -4
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < -2 }
					value = 0.18 # offset -3
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < -1 }
						value = 0.08 # offset -2
					}
					else = {
						value = 0 # offset -1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 5 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 2 }
				value = 0 # offsets +0 to +1
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 3 }
					value = 0.28 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 4 }
						value = 1.01 # offset +3
					}
					else = {
						value = 2.06 # offset +4
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 8 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 6 }
					value = 2.56 # offset +5
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 7 }
						value = 2.29 # offset +6
					}
					else = {
						value = 2.01 # offset +7
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 9 }
					value = 1.75 # offset +8
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 10 }
						value = 1.5 # offset +9
					}
					else = {
						value = 1.26 # offset +10
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
sr_launch_premium_ntp_venus = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < -5 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < -8 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < -9 }
					value = 0.45 # offset -10
				}
				else = {
					value = 0.39 # offset -9
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < -7 }
					value = 0.34 # offset -8
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < -6 }
						value = 0.28 # offset -7
					}
					else = {
						value = 0.22 # offset -6
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < -3 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < -4 }
					value = 0.17 # offset -5
				}
				else = {
					value = 0.12 # offset -4
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < -2 }
					value = 0.07 # offset -3
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < -1 }
						value = 0.03 # offset -2
					}
					else = {
						value = 0 # offset -1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 5 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 2 }
				value = 0 # offsets +0 to +1
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 3 }
					value = 0.11 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 4 }
						value = 0.33 # offset +3
					}
					else = {
						value = 0.58 # offset +4
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 8 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 6 }
					value = 0.68 # offset +5
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 7 }
						value = 0.63 # offset +6
					}
					else = {
						value = 0.57 # offset +7
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 9 }
					value = 0.52 # offset +8
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 10 }
						value = 0.46 # offset +9
					}
					else = {
						value = 0.4 # offset +10
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Transit months by drive (slices 2-3 design § 2): chemical the median Hohmann time (146 days) whatever the month; the others by months from the optimum,
# a departure on day 15 averaged over the same 16 cycles:
#   -10: fusion 3, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    -9: fusion 3, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    -8: fusion 3, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    -7: fusion 5, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    -6: fusion 5, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    -5: fusion 5, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    -4: fusion 4, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    -3: fusion 4, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    -2: fusion 3, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    -1: fusion 2, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +0: fusion 2, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +1: fusion 1, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +2: fusion 1, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +3: fusion 1, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +4: fusion 2, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +5: fusion 2, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +6: fusion 3, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +7: fusion 3, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +8: fusion 3, torch 1, antimatter 1
#    +9: fusion 3, torch 1, antimatter 1
#   +10: fusion 3, torch 1, antimatter 1
sr_transit_chemical_venus = { value = 5 }
sr_transit_fusion_venus = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < -5 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < -8 }
				value = 3 # offsets -10 to -9
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < -7 }
					value = 3 # offset -8
				}
				else = {
					value = 5 # offsets -7 to -6
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < -3 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < -4 }
					value = 5 # offset -5
				}
				else = {
					value = 4 # offset -4
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < -2 }
					value = 4 # offset -3
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < -1 }
						value = 3 # offset -2
					}
					else = {
						value = 2 # offset -1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 5 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 1 }
					value = 2 # offset +0
				}
				else = {
					value = 1 # offset +1
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 3 }
					value = 1 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 4 }
						value = 1 # offset +3
					}
					else = {
						value = 2 # offset +4
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 8 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_venus < 6 }
					value = 2 # offset +5
				}
				else = {
					value = 3 # offsets +6 to +7
				}
			}
			else = {
				value = 3 # offsets +8 to +10
			}
		}
	}
}
sr_transit_torch_venus = {
	value = 0
	value = 1 # offsets -10 to +10
}
sr_transit_antimatter_venus = {
	value = 0
	value = 1 # offsets -10 to +10
}

sr_window_next_optimum_saturn = {
	value = sr_window_next_saturn
	floor = yes
}
sr_window_previous_gap_saturn = {
	value = sr_window_next_saturn
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_saturn
	multiply = 100
	round = yes
}
sr_window_months_to_next_saturn = {
	value = sr_window_next_optimum_saturn
	subtract = 1
	subtract = te_history_month_index
	min = 0
}
sr_launch_offset_saturn = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_saturn
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_nearer_previous_saturn <= 0 }
		add = sr_window_previous_gap_saturn
	}
}
sr_launch_nearer_previous_saturn = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_saturn
	multiply = 2
	add = sr_window_previous_gap_saturn
}

# Premium by months from the optimum (fraction; 0.35 = +35%), from the mean extra delta-v of 16 cycles,
# chemical then nuclear thermal (sr_launch_premium_ntp_<body>, the same delta-v at 9 km/s):
#    -7:    3.21, NTP   0.81 (chemical cycles 140% to 1193%)
#    -6:   14.09, NTP   2.05 (chemical cycles 404% to 6719%)
#    -5:   74.27, NTP   4.91 (chemical cycles 2108% to 23185%)
#    -4:   74.24, NTP   4.91 (chemical cycles 3240% to 16449%)
#    -3:   13.68, NTP   2.02 (chemical cycles 604% to 2884%)
#    -2:    1.89, NTP   0.55 (chemical cycles 81% to 390%)
#    -1:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +0:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +1:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +2:    0.14, NTP   0.05 (chemical cycles 0% to 39%)
#    +3:    0.21, NTP   0.08 (chemical cycles 0% to 50%)
#    +4:    0.55, NTP    0.2 (chemical cycles 2% to 229%)
#    +5:    1.87, NTP   0.54 (chemical cycles 42% to 602%)
#    +6:     7.1, NTP   1.36 (chemical cycles 255% to 3299%)
#    +7:   37.63, NTP   3.49 (chemical cycles 998% to 17873%)
sr_launch_premium_saturn = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < -4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < -6 }
				value = 3.21 # offset -7
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < -5 }
					value = 14.09 # offset -6
				}
				else = {
					value = 74.27 # offset -5
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < -2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < -3 }
					value = 74.24 # offset -4
				}
				else = {
					value = 13.68 # offset -3
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < -1 }
					value = 1.89 # offset -2
				}
				else = {
					value = 0 # offset -1
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 2 }
				value = 0 # offsets +0 to +1
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 3 }
					value = 0.14 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					value = 0.21 # offset +3
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 6 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 5 }
					value = 0.55 # offset +4
				}
				else = {
					value = 1.87 # offset +5
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 7 }
					value = 7.1 # offset +6
				}
				else = {
					value = 37.63 # offset +7
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Transit months by drive (slices 2-3 design § 2): chemical the median Hohmann time (2221 days) whatever the month; the others by months from the optimum,
# a departure on day 15 averaged over the same 16 cycles:
#    -7: fusion 73, torch 3, antimatter 2
#    -6: fusion 73, torch 3, antimatter 2
#    -5: fusion 73, torch 4, antimatter 2
#    -4: fusion 31, torch 4, antimatter 2
#    -3: fusion 24, torch 4, antimatter 2
#    -2: fusion 22, torch 4, antimatter 2
#    -1: fusion 18, torch 4, antimatter 2
#    +0: fusion 16, torch 4, antimatter 2
#    +1: fusion 16, torch 3, antimatter 2
#    +2: fusion 19, torch 3, antimatter 2
#    +3: fusion 34, torch 3, antimatter 2
#    +4: fusion 67, torch 3, antimatter 2
#    +5: fusion 73, torch 3, antimatter 2
#    +6: fusion 73, torch 3, antimatter 2
#    +7: fusion 73, torch 4, antimatter 2
sr_transit_chemical_saturn = { value = 73 }
sr_transit_fusion_saturn = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < -4 }
			value = 73 # offsets -7 to -5
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < -2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < -3 }
					value = 31 # offset -4
				}
				else = {
					value = 24 # offset -3
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < -1 }
					value = 22 # offset -2
				}
				else = {
					value = 18 # offset -1
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 2 }
				value = 16 # offsets +0 to +1
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 3 }
					value = 19 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					value = 34 # offset +3
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 6 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 5 }
					value = 67 # offset +4
				}
				else = {
					value = 73 # offset +5
				}
			}
			else = {
				value = 73 # offsets +6 to +7
			}
		}
	}
}
sr_transit_torch_saturn = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < -4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < -6 }
				value = 3 # offset -7
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < -5 }
					value = 3 # offset -6
				}
				else = {
					value = 4 # offset -5
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			value = 4 # offsets -4 to -1
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 1 }
					value = 4 # offset +0
				}
				else = {
					value = 3 # offset +1
				}
			}
			else = {
				value = 3 # offsets +2 to +3
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 6 }
				value = 3 # offsets +4 to +5
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 7 }
					value = 3 # offset +6
				}
				else = {
					value = 4 # offset +7
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
sr_transit_antimatter_saturn = {
	value = 0
	value = 2 # offsets -7 to +7
}

sr_window_next_optimum_uranus = {
	value = sr_window_next_uranus
	floor = yes
}
sr_window_previous_gap_uranus = {
	value = sr_window_next_uranus
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_uranus
	multiply = 100
	round = yes
}
sr_window_months_to_next_uranus = {
	value = sr_window_next_optimum_uranus
	subtract = 1
	subtract = te_history_month_index
	min = 0
}
sr_launch_offset_uranus = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_uranus
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_nearer_previous_uranus <= 0 }
		add = sr_window_previous_gap_uranus
	}
}
sr_launch_nearer_previous_uranus = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_uranus
	multiply = 2
	add = sr_window_previous_gap_uranus
}

# Premium by months from the optimum (fraction; 0.35 = +35%), from the mean extra delta-v of 16 cycles,
# chemical then nuclear thermal (sr_launch_premium_ntp_<body>, the same delta-v at 9 km/s):
#    -7:    2.76, NTP   0.72 (chemical cycles 54% to 1087%)
#    -6:   16.75, NTP   2.26 (chemical cycles 446% to 7076%)
#    -5:   98.08, NTP   5.62 (chemical cycles 2976% to 27805%)
#    -4:   84.36, NTP   5.22 (chemical cycles 3323% to 25841%)
#    -3:   13.99, NTP   2.04 (chemical cycles 551% to 3995%)
#    -2:    1.64, NTP   0.49 (chemical cycles 50% to 446%)
#    -1:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +0:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +1:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +2:    0.08, NTP   0.03 (chemical cycles 2% to 17%)
#    +3:    0.15, NTP   0.06 (chemical cycles 5% to 23%)
#    +4:    0.45, NTP   0.16 (chemical cycles 8% to 121%)
#    +5:    2.15, NTP    0.6 (chemical cycles 42% to 829%)
#    +6:   12.95, NTP   1.95 (chemical cycles 327% to 5377%)
#    +7:   79.96, NTP   5.09 (chemical cycles 2208% to 29025%)
sr_launch_premium_uranus = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < -4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < -6 }
				value = 2.76 # offset -7
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < -5 }
					value = 16.75 # offset -6
				}
				else = {
					value = 98.08 # offset -5
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < -2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < -3 }
					value = 84.36 # offset -4
				}
				else = {
					value = 13.99 # offset -3
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < -1 }
					value = 1.64 # offset -2
				}
				else = {
					value = 0 # offset -1
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < 4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < 2 }
				value = 0 # offsets +0 to +1
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < 3 }
					value = 0.08 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					value = 0.15 # offset +3
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < 6 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < 5 }
					value = 0.45 # offset +4
				}
				else = {
					value = 2.15 # offset +5
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < 7 }
					value = 12.95 # offset +6
				}
				else = {
					value = 79.96 # offset +7
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
sr_launch_premium_ntp_uranus = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < -4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < -6 }
				value = 0.72 # offset -7
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < -5 }
					value = 2.26 # offset -6
				}
				else = {
					value = 5.62 # offset -5
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < -2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < -3 }
					value = 5.22 # offset -4
				}
				else = {
					value = 2.04 # offset -3
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < -1 }
					value = 0.49 # offset -2
				}
				else = {
					value = 0 # offset -1
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < 4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < 2 }
				value = 0 # offsets +0 to +1
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < 3 }
					value = 0.03 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					value = 0.06 # offset +3
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < 6 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < 5 }
					value = 0.16 # offset +4
				}
				else = {
					value = 0.6 # offset +5
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < 7 }
					value = 1.95 # offset +6
				}
				else = {
					value = 5.09 # offset +7
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Transit months by drive (slices 2-3 design § 2): chemical the median Hohmann time (5853 days) whatever the month; the others by months from the optimum,
# a departure on day 15 averaged over the same 16 cycles:
#    -7: fusion 192, torch 6, antimatter 2
#    -6: fusion 192, torch 6, antimatter 2
#    -5: fusion 192, torch 6, antimatter 2
#    -4: fusion 82, torch 6, antimatter 2
#    -3: fusion 56, torch 6, antimatter 2
#    -2: fusion 47, torch 7, antimatter 2
#    -1: fusion 40, torch 6, antimatter 2
#    +0: fusion 37, torch 6, antimatter 2
#    +1: fusion 38, torch 6, antimatter 2
#    +2: fusion 54, torch 6, antimatter 2
#    +3: fusion 107, torch 6, antimatter 2
#    +4: fusion 192, torch 6, antimatter 2
#    +5: fusion 192, torch 6, antimatter 2
#    +6: fusion 192, torch 6, antimatter 2
#    +7: fusion 192, torch 6, antimatter 2
sr_transit_chemical_uranus = { value = 192 }
sr_transit_fusion_uranus = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < -4 }
			value = 192 # offsets -7 to -5
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < -2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < -3 }
					value = 82 # offset -4
				}
				else = {
					value = 56 # offset -3
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < -1 }
					value = 47 # offset -2
				}
				else = {
					value = 40 # offset -1
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < 4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < 2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < 1 }
					value = 37 # offset +0
				}
				else = {
					value = 38 # offset +1
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < 3 }
					value = 54 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					value = 107 # offset +3
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			value = 192 # offsets +4 to +7
		}
	}
}
sr_transit_torch_uranus = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < -4 }
			value = 6 # offsets -7 to -5
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < -2 }
				value = 6 # offsets -4 to -3
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_uranus < -1 }
					value = 7 # offset -2
				}
				else = {
					value = 6 # offset -1
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		value = 6 # offsets +0 to +7
	}
}
sr_transit_antimatter_uranus = {
	value = 0
	value = 2 # offsets -7 to +7
}

# ===== Neptune system (237 windows) =====

	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { year < 1920 }
		if = { limit = { te_history_month_index <= 22796 } value = 22795.12 } # 1899.07–1899.09
		else_if = { limit = { te_history_month_index <= 22808 } value = 22807.12 } # 1900.07–1900.09
		else_if = { limit = { te_history_month_index <= 22820 } value = 22819.12 } # 1901.07–1901.09

		else_if = { limit = { te_history_month_index <= 22845 } value = 22844.12 } # 1903.08–1903.10
		else_if = { limit = { te_history_month_index <= 22857 } value = 22856.12 } # 1904.08–1904.10
