sr_window_next_optimum_neptune = {
	value = sr_window_next_neptune
	floor = yes
}
sr_window_previous_gap_neptune = {
	value = sr_window_next_neptune
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_neptune
	multiply = 100
	round = yes
}
sr_window_months_to_next_neptune = {
	value = sr_window_next_optimum_neptune
	subtract = 1
	subtract = te_history_month_index
	min = 0
}
sr_launch_offset_neptune = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_neptune
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_nearer_previous_neptune <= 0 }
		add = sr_window_previous_gap_neptune
	}
}
sr_launch_nearer_previous_neptune = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_neptune
	multiply = 2
	add = sr_window_previous_gap_neptune
}

# Premium by months from the optimum (fraction; 0.35 = +35%), from the mean extra delta-v of 16 cycles,
# chemical then nuclear thermal (sr_launch_premium_ntp_<body>, the same delta-v at 9 km/s):
#    -7:    1.99, NTP   0.57 (chemical cycles 69% to 485%)
#    -6:   12.69, NTP   1.93 (chemical cycles 491% to 3331%)
#    -5:   79.22, NTP   5.07 (chemical cycles 3272% to 21957%)
#    -4:   83.21, NTP   5.19 (chemical cycles 2777% to 21086%)
#    -3:   13.53, NTP      2 (chemical cycles 456% to 3634%)
#    -2:    1.56, NTP   0.47 (chemical cycles 34% to 415%)
#    -1:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +0:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +1:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +2:    0.07, NTP   0.03 (chemical cycles 0% to 30%)
#    +3:    0.11, NTP   0.04 (chemical cycles 0% to 33%)
#    +4:    0.39, NTP   0.15 (chemical cycles 0% to 96%)
#    +5:    1.74, NTP   0.51 (chemical cycles 59% to 413%)
#    +6:   11.07, NTP   1.78 (chemical cycles 419% to 2859%)
#    +7:   69.69, NTP   4.76 (chemical cycles 2807% to 18853%)
sr_launch_premium_neptune = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < -4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < -6 }
				value = 1.99 # offset -7
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < -5 }
					value = 12.69 # offset -6
				}
				else = {
					value = 79.22 # offset -5
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < -2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < -3 }
					value = 83.21 # offset -4
				}
				else = {
					value = 13.53 # offset -3
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < -1 }
					value = 1.56 # offset -2
				}
				else = {
					value = 0 # offset -1
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < 4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < 2 }
				value = 0 # offsets +0 to +1
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < 3 }
					value = 0.07 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					value = 0.11 # offset +3
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < 6 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < 5 }
					value = 0.39 # offset +4
				}
				else = {
					value = 1.74 # offset +5
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < 7 }
					value = 11.07 # offset +6
				}
				else = {
					value = 69.69 # offset +7
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
sr_launch_premium_ntp_neptune = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < -4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < -6 }
				value = 0.57 # offset -7
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < -5 }
					value = 1.93 # offset -6
				}
				else = {
					value = 5.07 # offset -5
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < -2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < -3 }
					value = 5.19 # offset -4
				}
				else = {
					value = 2 # offset -3
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < -1 }
					value = 0.47 # offset -2
				}
				else = {
					value = 0 # offset -1
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < 4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < 2 }
				value = 0 # offsets +0 to +1
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < 3 }
					value = 0.03 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					value = 0.04 # offset +3
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < 6 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < 5 }
					value = 0.15 # offset +4
				}
				else = {
					value = 0.51 # offset +5
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < 7 }
					value = 1.78 # offset +6
				}
				else = {
					value = 4.76 # offset +7
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Transit months by drive (slices 2-3 design § 2): chemical the median Hohmann time (11240 days) whatever the month; the others by months from the optimum,
# a departure on day 15 averaged over the same 16 cycles:
#    -7: fusion 369, torch 9, antimatter 3
#    -6: fusion 369, torch 9, antimatter 3
#    -5: fusion 369, torch 9, antimatter 3
#    -4: fusion 153, torch 9, antimatter 3
#    -3: fusion 90, torch 10, antimatter 3
#    -2: fusion 77, torch 10, antimatter 3
#    -1: fusion 63, torch 10, antimatter 3
#    +0: fusion 57, torch 9, antimatter 3
#    +1: fusion 61, torch 9, antimatter 3
#    +2: fusion 91, torch 9, antimatter 3
#    +3: fusion 203, torch 9, antimatter 3
#    +4: fusion 369, torch 9, antimatter 3
#    +5: fusion 369, torch 9, antimatter 3
#    +6: fusion 369, torch 9, antimatter 3
#    +7: fusion 369, torch 9, antimatter 3
sr_transit_chemical_neptune = { value = 369 }
sr_transit_fusion_neptune = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < -4 }
			value = 369 # offsets -7 to -5
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < -2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < -3 }
					value = 153 # offset -4
				}
				else = {
					value = 90 # offset -3
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < -1 }
					value = 77 # offset -2
				}
				else = {
					value = 63 # offset -1
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < 4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < 2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < 1 }
					value = 57 # offset +0
				}
				else = {
					value = 61 # offset +1
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < 3 }
					value = 91 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					value = 203 # offset +3
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			value = 369 # offsets +4 to +7
		}
	}
}
sr_transit_torch_neptune = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < -4 }
			value = 9 # offsets -7 to -5
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < -2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_neptune < -3 }
					value = 9 # offset -4
				}
				else = {
					value = 10 # offset -3
				}
			}
			else = {
				value = 10 # offsets -2 to -1
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		value = 9 # offsets +0 to +7
	}
}
sr_transit_antimatter_neptune = {
	value = 0
	value = 3 # offsets -7 to +7
}

sr_window_next_optimum_kuiper = {
	value = sr_window_next_kuiper
	floor = yes
}
sr_window_previous_gap_kuiper = {
	value = sr_window_next_kuiper
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_kuiper
	multiply = 100
	round = yes
}
sr_window_months_to_next_kuiper = {
	value = sr_window_next_optimum_kuiper
	subtract = 1
	subtract = te_history_month_index
	min = 0
}
sr_launch_offset_kuiper = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_kuiper
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_nearer_previous_kuiper <= 0 }
		add = sr_window_previous_gap_kuiper
	}
}
sr_launch_nearer_previous_kuiper = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = sr_window_next_optimum_kuiper
	multiply = 2
	add = sr_window_previous_gap_kuiper
}

# Premium by months from the optimum (fraction; 0.35 = +35%), from the mean extra delta-v of 16 cycles,
# chemical then nuclear thermal (sr_launch_premium_ntp_<body>, the same delta-v at 9 km/s):
#    -7:    5.67, NTP   1.18 (chemical cycles 0% to 4203%)
#    -6:   14.34, NTP   2.07 (chemical cycles 3% to 17828%)
#    -5:   37.84, NTP    3.5 (chemical cycles 102% to 54166%)
#    -4:   33.58, NTP   3.29 (chemical cycles 202% to 25978%)
#    -3:   14.22, NTP   2.06 (chemical cycles 274% to 4321%)
#    -2:    3.18, NTP    0.8 (chemical cycles 38% to 875%)
#    -1:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +0:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +1:       0, NTP      0 (window, free)
#    +2:    0.43, NTP   0.16 (chemical cycles 0% to 384%)
#    +3:    1.37, NTP   0.43 (chemical cycles 0% to 902%)
#    +4:    2.16, NTP    0.6 (chemical cycles 0% to 1290%)
#    +5:    5.52, NTP   1.16 (chemical cycles 0% to 4209%)
#    +6:   13.73, NTP   2.02 (chemical cycles 4% to 16306%)
#    +7:    36.8, NTP   3.45 (chemical cycles 103% to 58670%)
sr_launch_premium_kuiper = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < -4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < -6 }
				value = 5.67 # offset -7
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < -5 }
					value = 14.34 # offset -6
				}
				else = {
					value = 37.84 # offset -5
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < -2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < -3 }
					value = 33.58 # offset -4
				}
				else = {
					value = 14.22 # offset -3
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < -1 }
					value = 3.18 # offset -2
				}
				else = {
					value = 0 # offset -1
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < 4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < 2 }
				value = 0 # offsets +0 to +1
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < 3 }
					value = 0.43 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					value = 1.37 # offset +3
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < 6 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < 5 }
					value = 2.16 # offset +4
				}
				else = {
					value = 5.52 # offset +5
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < 7 }
					value = 13.73 # offset +6
				}
				else = {
					value = 36.8 # offset +7
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
sr_launch_premium_ntp_kuiper = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < -4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < -6 }
				value = 1.18 # offset -7
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < -5 }
					value = 2.07 # offset -6
				}
				else = {
					value = 3.5 # offset -5
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < -2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < -3 }
					value = 3.29 # offset -4
				}
				else = {
					value = 2.06 # offset -3
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < -1 }
					value = 0.8 # offset -2
				}
				else = {
					value = 0 # offset -1
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < 4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < 2 }
				value = 0 # offsets +0 to +1
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < 3 }
					value = 0.16 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					value = 0.43 # offset +3
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < 6 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < 5 }
					value = 0.6 # offset +4
				}
				else = {
					value = 1.16 # offset +5
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < 7 }
					value = 2.02 # offset +6
				}
				else = {
					value = 3.45 # offset +7
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Transit months by drive (slices 2-3 design § 2): chemical the median Hohmann time (18610 days) whatever the month; the others by months from the optimum,
# a departure on day 15 averaged over the same 16 cycles:
#    -7: fusion 611, torch 12, antimatter 4
#    -6: fusion 611, torch 12, antimatter 4
#    -5: fusion 611, torch 12, antimatter 4
#    -4: fusion 611, torch 13, antimatter 4
#    -3: fusion 222, torch 13, antimatter 4
#    -2: fusion 218, torch 13, antimatter 4
#    -1: fusion 303, torch 13, antimatter 4
#    +0: fusion 133, torch 13, antimatter 4
#    +1: fusion 150, torch 12, antimatter 4
#    +2: fusion 243, torch 12, antimatter 4
#    +3: fusion 459, torch 12, antimatter 4
#    +4: fusion 611, torch 12, antimatter 4
#    +5: fusion 611, torch 12, antimatter 4
#    +6: fusion 611, torch 12, antimatter 4
#    +7: fusion 611, torch 12, antimatter 4
sr_transit_chemical_kuiper = { value = 611 }
sr_transit_fusion_kuiper = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < -4 }
			value = 611 # offsets -7 to -5
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < -2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < -3 }
					value = 611 # offset -4
				}
				else = {
					value = 222 # offset -3
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < -1 }
					value = 218 # offset -2
				}
				else = {
					value = 303 # offset -1
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < 4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < 2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < 1 }
					value = 133 # offset +0
				}
				else = {
					value = 150 # offset +1
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < 3 }
					value = 243 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					value = 459 # offset +3
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			value = 611 # offsets +4 to +7
		}
	}
}
sr_transit_torch_kuiper = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < -4 }
			value = 12 # offsets -7 to -5
		}
		else = {
			value = 13 # offsets -4 to -1
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < 4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < 2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_kuiper < 1 }
					value = 13 # offset +0
				}
				else = {
					value = 12 # offset +1
				}
			}
			else = {
				value = 12 # offsets +2 to +3
			}
		}
		else = {
			value = 12 # offsets +4 to +7
		}
	}
}
sr_transit_antimatter_kuiper = {
	value = 0
	value = 4 # offsets -7 to +7
}

# ===== Transit only: a body with no launch window =====
# One figure per drive, the mean over 240 months spread across the span.
# Mercury: the median Hohmann time is 107 days
sr_transit_chemical_mercury = { value = 4 }
sr_transit_fusion_mercury = { value = 3 }
sr_transit_torch_mercury = { value = 1 }
sr_transit_antimatter_mercury = { value = 1 }

# ===== Readers of the window cache (sr_launch_windows_refresh_cache) =====
# sr_window_body_code_<body>    the body's number in BODIES order, for debug
#                               lines, which can't name a $BODY$ (BODY_CODE_LEGEND)
# sr_window_wait_months_<body>  months to its next window, cached (0 if none yet)
# sr_window_premium_now_<body>  this month's premium, cached (0 if none yet)
# sr_window_premium_now_ntp_<body>  the same for nuclear thermal engines (the
#                               date's own figure, sr_launch_premium_ntp_<body>,
#                               if none yet)
# sr_window_premium_country_<body>  country: the one its engines pay, nuclear
#                               thermal with Nuclear Thermal Propulsion
#                               (sr_launch_has_ntp), chemical otherwise. Every
#                               reader below that prices a launch reads this.
# sr_launch_cost_<body>         country: the premium it launches there at now, 0
#                               in a window or with fusion drives, sr_launch_never
#                               if it can't (sr_launch_departs_free / _paid,
#                               common/scripted_triggers/sr_launch_window_triggers.txt)
# sr_launch_months_cost_<body>  country: goal x premium / pace, the months the
#                               premium sets every later colony back
# sr_window_disp_verdict_<body> country, the panel's verdict on launching there
#                               now outside its window: 1 the approach would,
#                               0 it waits, 2 Safe (never off-window)
# sr_transit_months_<body>      country: the months a colony fleet leaving now
#                               takes, by its drive (sr_drive_level), from the
#                               month's cache sr_window_transit_<drive>_<body>
#                               (chemical, a constant, needs none)
# sr_launch_target_cost_<body>  country: the premium a fleet bound for a chosen
#                               world of the body leaves at now (0 in a window or
#                               with a torch), sr_launch_never if it can't
#                               (sr_launch_target_departs_paid: the approach's test
#                               against the body's own wait, not the stage's,
#                               sr_launch_target_months_allowed_<body> = k x it)

sr_transit_months_mars = {
	value = sr_transit_chemical_mars
	if = { limit = { sr_drive_level >= 3 has_global_variable = sr_window_transit_antimatter_mars } value = global_var:sr_window_transit_antimatter_mars }
	else_if = { limit = { sr_drive_level >= 2 has_global_variable = sr_window_transit_torch_mars } value = global_var:sr_window_transit_torch_mars }
	else_if = { limit = { sr_drive_level >= 1 has_global_variable = sr_window_transit_fusion_mars } value = global_var:sr_window_transit_fusion_mars }
}
sr_launch_target_cost_mars = {
	value = sr_launch_never
	if = { limit = { sr_launch_departs_free = { BODY = mars } } value = 0 }
	else_if = { limit = { sr_launch_target_departs_paid = { BODY = mars } } value = sr_window_premium_country_mars }
}
sr_launch_target_months_allowed_mars = {
	value = sr_window_wait_months_mars
	multiply = sr_launch_approach_weight
}
# Mars
sr_window_body_code_mars = { value = 1 }
sr_window_wait_months_mars = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_window_wait_mars } value = global_var:sr_window_wait_mars }
}
sr_window_premium_now_mars = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_window_cost_mars } value = global_var:sr_window_cost_mars }
}
sr_window_premium_now_ntp_mars = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_window_cost_ntp_mars } value = global_var:sr_window_cost_ntp_mars }
	else = { value = sr_launch_premium_ntp_mars }
}
sr_window_premium_country_mars = {
	value = sr_window_premium_now_mars
	if = { limit = { sr_launch_has_ntp = yes } value = sr_window_premium_now_ntp_mars }
}
sr_launch_cost_mars = {
	value = sr_launch_never
	if = { limit = { sr_launch_departs_free = { BODY = mars } } value = 0 }
	else_if = { limit = { sr_launch_departs_paid = { BODY = mars } } value = sr_window_premium_country_mars }
}
sr_launch_months_cost_mars = {
	value = sr_solar_colonization_goal
	multiply = sr_window_premium_country_mars
	divide = sr_pace_rate_solar_colonization
}
sr_window_disp_verdict_mars = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_safe_solar_colonization } value = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { sr_launch_departs_paid = { BODY = mars } } value = 1 }
}

	value = sr_launch_never
	if = { limit = { sr_launch_departs_free = { BODY = jupiter } } value = 0 }
	else_if = { limit = { sr_launch_target_departs_paid = { BODY = jupiter } } value = sr_window_premium_country_jupiter }
}
sr_launch_target_months_allowed_jupiter = {
	value = sr_window_wait_months_jupiter
	multiply = sr_launch_approach_weight
}
# Jupiter system
sr_window_body_code_jupiter = { value = 7 }
sr_window_wait_months_jupiter = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_window_wait_jupiter } value = global_var:sr_window_wait_jupiter }
}
sr_window_premium_now_jupiter = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_window_cost_jupiter } value = global_var:sr_window_cost_jupiter }
}
sr_window_premium_now_ntp_jupiter = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_window_cost_ntp_jupiter } value = global_var:sr_window_cost_ntp_jupiter }
	else = { value = sr_launch_premium_ntp_jupiter }
}
sr_window_premium_country_jupiter = {
	value = sr_window_premium_now_jupiter
	if = { limit = { sr_launch_has_ntp = yes } value = sr_window_premium_now_ntp_jupiter }
}
sr_launch_cost_jupiter = {
	value = sr_launch_never
	if = { limit = { sr_launch_departs_free = { BODY = jupiter } } value = 0 }
	else_if = { limit = { sr_launch_departs_paid = { BODY = jupiter } } value = sr_window_premium_country_jupiter }
}
sr_launch_months_cost_jupiter = {
	value = sr_solar_colonization_goal
	multiply = sr_window_premium_country_jupiter
	divide = sr_pace_rate_solar_colonization
}
sr_window_disp_verdict_jupiter = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_safe_solar_colonization } value = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { sr_launch_departs_paid = { BODY = jupiter } } value = 1 }
}

# Mercury (no window)
sr_transit_months_mercury = {
	value = sr_transit_chemical_mercury
	if = { limit = { sr_drive_level >= 3 } value = sr_transit_antimatter_mercury }
	else_if = { limit = { sr_drive_level >= 2 } value = sr_transit_torch_mercury }
	else_if = { limit = { sr_drive_level >= 1 } value = sr_transit_fusion_mercury }
}

# The stage's soonest window among its unclaimed sites (m in the off-window
# rule, spec § 5.2a): 0 while one is open or Mercury is left; sr_launch_never
# when the stage has nothing left. Any scope.
sr_window_stage_wait = {
	value = sr_launch_never
	if = { limit = { sr_window_body_in_play_mars = yes } max = sr_window_wait_months_mars }
	if = { limit = { sr_window_body_in_play_ceres = yes } max = sr_window_wait_months_ceres }
	if = { limit = { sr_window_body_in_play_vesta = yes } max = sr_window_wait_months_vesta }
	if = { limit = { sr_window_body_in_play_psyche = yes } max = sr_window_wait_months_psyche }
	if = { limit = { sr_window_body_in_play_pallas = yes } max = sr_window_wait_months_pallas }
	if = { limit = { sr_window_body_in_play_hygiea = yes } max = sr_window_wait_months_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { sr_window_body_in_play_jupiter = yes } max = sr_window_wait_months_jupiter }
	if = { limit = { sr_window_body_in_play_venus = yes } max = sr_window_wait_months_venus }
	if = { limit = { sr_window_body_in_play_saturn = yes } max = sr_window_wait_months_saturn }
	if = { limit = { sr_window_body_in_play_uranus = yes } max = sr_window_wait_months_uranus }
	if = { limit = { sr_window_body_in_play_neptune = yes } max = sr_window_wait_months_neptune }
	if = { limit = { sr_window_body_in_play_kuiper = yes } max = sr_window_wait_months_kuiper }
	if = { limit = { sr_window_mercury_in_play = yes } max = 0 }
}

# The cheapest premium this country can launch at now, over the stage's
# unclaimed sites; sr_launch_never when none can depart. Country scope.
sr_launch_best_cost = {
	value = sr_launch_never
	max = sr_launch_cost_mars
	max = sr_launch_cost_ceres
	max = sr_launch_cost_vesta
	max = sr_launch_cost_psyche
	max = sr_launch_cost_pallas
	max = sr_launch_cost_hygiea
	max = sr_launch_cost_jupiter
	max = sr_launch_cost_venus
	max = sr_launch_cost_saturn
	max = sr_launch_cost_uranus
	max = sr_launch_cost_neptune
	max = sr_launch_cost_kuiper
	if = { limit = { sr_window_mercury_in_play = yes } max = 0 }
}
